inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate the edge if Salobo slips or underdelivers, copper remains immaterial to group cash flow, or recycling, substitution and new mine supply close the structural scarcity gap.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Higher copper prices and persistent concentrate scarcity can improve Vale Base Metals cash flow, while Salobo coarse-particle flotation can add up to approximately 30,000 tonnes of annual copper output; exposure is moderated because iron ore remains the dominant group driver.

objective: Review whether Vale has a material causal relationship to critical minerals and structural copper scarcity using current primary evidence; accept or reject the edge.
